title: Clone Graph
description: Given an adjacency list representing a connected undirected graph, return a deep copy (clone) of the graph representation.

hints.content: Use a hash map to map original nodes to their cloned copies.
DFS or BFS traversing every edge.
Deep copying an adjacency list creates an independent replica of all neighbor arrays.

solution.explanation:
Deep clone of graph adjacency list. Creates distinct array references for all node neighbor lists.
Time Complexity: O(V + E)
Space Complexity: O(V + E)
